sets.relationshipLabel: the device and the fuel it consumes
sets.explanation: A locomotive runs on coal just as a lantern runs on oil — each pair names the device first and the fuel it depends on second, in that fixed order.

sets.relationshipLabel: the thing described, followed by the document that describes it
sets.explanation: A journey is written up as a timetable and cargo is written up as a manifest — each pair moves from the real thing to the paper that accounts for it.

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and end of a span of time
sets.explanation: Boarding and disembarking bookend a journey the way dusk and dawn bookend a night — each pair marks a beginning and its matching end.

sets.relationshipLabel: the one thing this stretch can never hold
sets.explanation: Night can never contain sunlight and a tunnel can never contain open sky — each pair names the one thing definitionally excluded from that stretch.
